name: forkyard.repos.get
description: Read one repository, including contribution rules and roles.

name: forkyard.repos.search
description: Search repository names and descriptions.

name: forkyard.repos.files.list
description: List files at a branch, tag or commit. Binary paths are named and not returned as text.

name: forkyard.repos.files.read
description: Read one UTF-8 file at a ref.

name: forkyard.issues.list
description: List issues in a repository.

name: forkyard.issues.get
description: Read one issue and its comments.

name: forkyard.pulls.list
description: List pull requests in a repository.

name: forkyard.pulls.get
description: Read one pull request, its comments and its reviews.

name: forkyard.pulls.diff
description: Return the unified text diff between a pull request base and head.

name: forkyard.pulls.timeline
description: Read the retained timeline of a pull request.

name: forkyard.people.get
description: Read a public profile by account id or handle. Profile links are returned as text.

name: forkyard.people.activity
description: Read public commits, pull requests, reviews and comments for an account, newest first.

name: forkyard.people.search
description: Search handles, display names and bios with case and diacritic folding.

name: forkyard.notifications.list
description: List notifications for the bound account.

name: forkyard.commits.list
description: List commits reachable from a ref, newest first.

name: forkyard.commits.get
description: Read one commit, its parents and its file delta.

name: forkyard.commits.compare
description: Compare two refs. Returns ahead_by, behind_by, merge_base and base_is_ancestor.

name: forkyard.tags.list
description: List tags in a repository.

name: forkyard.releases.list
description: List draft and published releases.

name: forkyard.releases.get
description: Read one release, including notes, asset digests and the publication receipt.

name: forkyard.checks.list
description: Read seeded check runs for one commit. Forkyard does not run them.

name: forkyard.forks.create
description: Fork a repository into the bound account.

name: forkyard.commits.push
description: Commit full text files on a branch the bound account can push, and record the line diff.

name: forkyard.issues.comment
description: Comment on an issue as the bound account.

name: forkyard.pulls.open
description: Open a pull request from an owner/name:branch head into a base branch.

name: forkyard.pulls.update
description: Update the title, description or draft flag of a pull request the bound account opened.

name: forkyard.pulls.comment
description: Comment on a pull request as the bound account.

name: forkyard.pulls.review_reply
description: Reply in a review thread as the bound account.

name: forkyard.pulls.request_review
description: Request a review from an account.

name: forkyard.pulls.reopen
description: Reopen a closed pull request when policy and the head branch allow it.

name: forkyard.pulls.close
description: Close a pull request the bound account opened.

name: forkyard.comments.edit
description: Edit the bound account's own comment. The previous text stays in the revision history.

name: forkyard.comments.delete
description: Mark the bound account's own comment deleted. The text stays in the revision history.

name: forkyard.reactions.set
description: Set or clear the bound account's reaction on a comment.

name: forkyard.people.follow
description: Follow an account.

name: forkyard.people.unfollow
description: Stop following an account.

name: forkyard.people.block
description: Block an account and drop the follow edges between you.

name: forkyard.people.unblock
description: Remove a block created by the bound account.

name: forkyard.profile.update_self
description: Update the bound account profile. Links are stored as text.

name: forkyard.notifications.mark_read
description: Mark one of the bound account's notifications read.

name: forkyard.tags.create
description: Create a tag at a commit on a repository the bound account can push.

name: forkyard.releases.create_draft
description: Create a draft release for an existing tag. Asset rows are names, sizes and sha256 digests.

name: forkyard.releases.update_draft
description: Update a draft release. Requires the draft revision.

name: forkyard.releases.publish
description: Publish a draft release at the named revision and record the release receipt.

name: forkyard.releases.delete_draft
description: Delete a draft release. Published releases stay.
